title: Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha protests outside Congress headquarters
seoTitle: Delhi protest against Congress by BJP women

tea.why: Protesters alleged that Congress leaders misbehaved with women police personnel during earlier demonstrations.
tea.want: Demanding a public apology from Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and the Congress party.
tea.changed: Oct 8, 2026: Police blocked the march near Hindi Bhawan, prompting a sit-in before participants were allowed to leave.

summary: On October 8, 2026, members of the Delhi Bharatiya Janata Party’s Mahila Morcha staged a protest near the Congress headquarters in Delhi. Organised by the BJP women's wing, the demonstration was directed against Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and other party members over allegations of misconduct involving women police personnel during earlier protests on Tuesday and Wednesday. Gathering near the Andhra Bhawan red light, participants marched toward Indira Bhawan raising slogans and demanding an apology. Police formed a heavy human barricade near Hindi Bhawan and forcibly stopped the march, after which demonstrators staged a sit-in before being allowed to leave. Leaders warned that the agitation would be intensified if similar behaviour continued.
response: Police formed a heavy human barricade near Hindi Bhawan to forcibly stop the march, and later issued warnings before allowing the protesters to leave.

updates.text: Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha members marched toward the Congress headquarters demanding an apology from Rahul Gandhi.
Police blocked the protesters near Hindi Bhawan with a heavy barricade, leading to a temporary sit-in.
